description: KOCGAN crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C20 H46 Gd2 N6 O14 2+,2(N1 O3 1-). From the CIF bond table, Gd1 (Gd) has 7 O neighbors; Gd2 (Gd) has 7 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.857-3.857 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 111.85-111.85°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C20H44Gd2N8O20. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 2 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
